name: Giving To Others
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of giving to others with a sincere heart, highlighting that acts of kindness toward those in need are seen as lending to the Lord Himself, who will repay generously (Proverbs 19:17). Jesus teaches that giving should be done discreetly, not for human recognition, but to store up eternal treasures in heaven (Matthew 6:1, 6:20). Genuine giving reflects compassion, meeting the physical needs of the hungry, thirsty, and strangers (Matthew 25:35), and is accompanied by the promise of abundant blessings returned in measure (Luke 6:38). The example of the widow’s offering observed by Jesus (Mark 12:41) further underscores the value of sacrificial giving regardless of wealth.
